caption: The drawing is rendered in shades of gray and depicts a single round object, resembling a plate or shallow bowl, with a central raised circular area. Above the plate, there is an ornate, symmetrical handle or decorative element with a pierced pattern containing circular, diamond, and heart-shaped cutouts, as well as small crosses. The plate and handle are drawn within a rectangular border. In the upper left corner, there is a smaller inset drawing of an emblem or coat of arms, which features a shield with the letters "S" and "F*M" surrounded by ornamental flourishes. At the bottom right corner, there is another small inset sketch showing a side view of the plate and part of the handle, with a faint symbol visible on the side of the plate. Beneath this corner sketch, the text "Hester Dumeny" is written. Along the bottom edge of the main rectangle, the following handwritten text appears: "1665. turn. att. hampsted. plains. march 25." The entire composition is set against a plain, off-white background, and all elements are drawn with finely shaded pencil or graphite lines.
title: Silver Porringer
